title: Mass. to be 4th state to roll out EBT chip cards to curb fraud
author: Morgan Rousseau
bullets: Massachusetts to issue chip-enabled EBT cards statewide to prevent SNAP benefit theft, starting after a successful pilot program.
Nearly 1 million residents use EBT cards at 5,500 retailers; the state distributes $2.6 billion in benefits annually.
Recipients can lock/unlock cards using the DTA Connect app; cards should be activated within 60 days of receipt.

title: Boston is now offering ‘pet certificates’ for couples who wed at City Hall
author: Morgan Rousseau
bullets: Boston City Hall now offers 'pet certificates' for couples getting married, recognizing pets as part of the household.
Mayor Michelle Wu introduced the program, emphasizing the role of pets in family life during wedding ceremonies.
The 'Family Companion Status Record' is the first pet certificate given under the City of Boston Department of Cuddles.

title: Kevin Nealon discusses Conan, Dunkin’, SNL and more ahead of local shows
author: Lauren Daley
bullets: Kevin Nealon discusses his New England ties and upcoming performances in Boston and Portsmouth, New Hampshire.
Nealon's comedic Twitter posts and social media presence bolster his material for his new stand-up special.
Nealon reflects on his experiences and career from his time on SNL to his 'Hiking with Kevin' YouTube series.

title: Red Sox’ Willson Contreras leaves game after scary HBP vs. Dodgers
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Red Sox's Willson Contreras was hit by a 95 MPH fastball from Dodgers pitcher Will Klein in the head.
Contreras remained in the game briefly after the hit but was later replaced for precautionary reasons.
As of Friday, Contreras leads Boston in batting average (.288), home runs (23), and RBI (67).

title: After Patriots coaching stint, DeAndre Hopkins joins Georgia Tech staff
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: DeAndre Hopkins joins Georgia Tech as an assistant wide receivers coach after a brief coaching stint with the Patriots.
Hopkins, 34, considered his future in football during Patriots training camp before deciding to pursue coaching.
Georgia Tech head coach David Key praised Hopkins for his knowledge and leadership, benefiting the players on and off the field.

title: Could Efton Chism and Kyle Williams both make the Patriots 53-man roster?
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Efton Chism and Kyle Williams are competing for a spot on the Patriots' 53-man roster during training camp.
The Patriots typically carry six wide receivers, but currently have seven strong candidates including Chism and Williams.
Williams impressed with recent catching ability, while Chism's strong performances have put him on other teams' radars.

title: Reports: OF George Springer interested in trade to Red Sox, team eyeing INF Xavier Edwards
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: George Springer, with an eight-team no-trade list, is reportedly open to a trade from the Blue Jays to the Red Sox.
The Red Sox are considering Miami Marlins' infielder Xavier Edwards as a potential addition amid recent injuries to key players.
Edwards, a switch-hitter, is known for his speed and consistent average, while Red Sox target Springer struggles during a down season.

title: 5 must-watch movies & TV shows streaming right now
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'The Devil Wears Prada 2' starring Meryl Streep and Anne Hathaway is now streaming on Hulu.
'The Drama', a dark comedy with Zendaya and Robert Pattinson, is available on HBO Max.
Season 1 of 'Furious', featuring Emmy Rossum as an FBI agent, is streaming on Hulu.

title: Here’s how home, away broadcasts reacted to Jarren Duran’s on-field flare-up
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Jarren Duran sparked controversy by calling out Red Sox teammate Willson Contreras and coach Chad Epperson during a game against the Athletics.
NESN and WEEI broadcasters expressed confusion and criticism over Duran's on-field actions and public display of frustration.
Red Sox are open to trading Duran before the MLB trade deadline, following his on-field incident and vocal displays of frustration.

title: Drake Maye on building chemistry with A.J. Brown: ‘I am not going to shy away from him.’
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Drake Maye and A.J. Brown build chemistry at Patriots training camp with increased completions.
Maye completed all but one pass in team drills, targeting Brown for various routes.
A.J. Brown's performance improved over the last two days, capitalizing on Maye's aggressive targeting.
